posts.text:
Over the past week, a serious vulnerability in Coldcard’s seed generation put funds across the Bitcoin ecosystem at risk. To date, no Nunchuk subscriber has lost any bitcoin.

This incident tested the principles we’ve built on since 2022. Here’s what happened, and why the architecture held:

posts.author: JWWeatherman_
posts.name: JW Weatherman
posts.text:
You guys offered a 2 of 3 multisig (2 keys required to spend) and you hold one key.

Then you used a cold card to generate it and didn’t tell users not to use another card, Making a single point of failure to steal bitcoin and that’s the exact reason people used you (was to create a multi vendor multisig).

Did I get anything wrong here?

If not any claim that funds haven’t been stolen is impossible to verify, but we do know funds were put at risk by knucklechucks.
